notes.title: Demo Update 0.5.1
notes.notes:
Added a refresh feature for in-game upgrades.

Enhanced the attack patterns of elite enemies.

notes.title: Demo Update 0.5
notes.notes:
Adjusted weapon and enemy stats for better balance.

Increased the pace of each round.

Added a progress bar on the right side.

Added a basic co-pilot system.

notes.title: Demo Update 0.4.1
notes.notes:
Added a feature to display damage numbers. Apologies for the delay in adding this...

Added a new weapon: Mayonnaise.

Fixed some weapon balance issues.

notes.title: Demo Update 0.4
notes.notes:
Changed the visual style to a retro CRT display effect.

Updated the display and evolution logic for weapon levels.

Optimized in-game icons for weapons and items.

New Weapon: Pineapple Grenade.

New Weapon: Biscuit Broadsword.

New Weapon: Cone Arrows.

New Weapon: Soda Can Mine.

notes.title: Demo Patch Update 08/02/2025
notes.notes: Boosted the performance of ALL weapons and reduced mid-to-late game difficulty (mainly by adjusting enemy spawn count and pacing). Hope everyone enjoys the more thrilling action!
